title.rendered: Top Offshore Development Destinations: Number of Developers, Salaries & More

content.rendered:
Are you challenged to keep up with the digital transformation’s growing demands while dealing with skyrocketing developer rates in your country? About 57% of businesses, too, are seeking ways to cut their expenses. The good news is offshore development teams come as a perfect solution to these concerns. Affordable IT staff augmentation services can be a viable way to scale your team while maintaining budgetary flexibility.

The global IT spending soars to $4.6 trillion in 2023, a substantial 5.5% increase from the previous year, and shows no signs of slowing down. In this scenario, choosing offshore destinations instead of hiring locally is a savvy strategy for finding qualified professionals with the necessary tech stack, reasonable costs, and well-established processes.

Mobilunity Insight

Further comments from Cyril Samovskiy, Mobilunity CEO, highlight that: “You commit to understanding that while your nearshore team is likely to share your loyalty and love to the Company of yours, they are physically located in another country and this location defines their needs and expectations to what is considered obvious and solved locally to you.”

The need for offshore specialists is undeniable, given the expanding IT outsourcing market: it’s projected to increase from $585 billion in 2023 to over $701 billion in 2028. Around 92% of the world’s top 500 companies leveraging offshore teams for day-to-day operations only add to this approach’s relevance.

If this cooperation option sounds viable to you, continue reading to find more details on the 16 best countries for offshore software development. Learn about the number of developers available, their salary rates, technology stacks, and beyond.

Most Popular Countries for Offshore Development

Let’s start our overview of the best offshore software development countries by exploring a vital aspect: the number of developers. Learning about the size of the talent pool in a particular destination is critical, as it directly impacts your ability to locate the right dev team. We’ve compiled a comprehensive table listing the number of developers according to such respective sources as Statista, LinkedIn, and Indeed.

Now that you’ve learned more about the talent pool in the top offshore software development countries, let’s proceed with the dev costs, popular tech stacks, prominent IT hubs, and successful startups.

As you can see in the table above, Eastern European and LATAM countries offer qualified talent at a compelling salary rate. While Western nations provide top-notch specialists as well, the offshore software development cost may be higher.

Why Are Eastern European Software Developers in Demand?

Offshore software development Ukraine, Poland, Romania, and Belarus, i.e., in Eastern European countries, is gaining prominence thanks to cost-effectiveness and decent quality. Yet, these aren’t the only reasons to hire developers here. Explore some facts about each of these countries to understand Eastern Europe’s unique advantages and considerations better.

Ukraine

Despite the uncertainties caused by Russia’s full-scale invasion, Ukraine not only stood firm but also managed to surpass its previous tech export revenues. As USAID reveals, the country’s tech sector experienced substantial growth of 38% during 2020 and 2021, making about $7 billion. One year into the war, Ukraine impressed everyone by generating $7.34 billion in export revenues — a 5% increase from 2021. Even more, the country retained jobs for over 285,000 ICT specialists.

Hiring an offshore software development team here means not only getting workers with certain programming skills but also being sure of their expertise and education. According to Statista, about 20,000 ICT students graduated in 2021. Their number is not going to decrease.

Speaking of employment, Ukraine boasts of having one of the world’s lowest personal income tax rates of 5%. Other surcharges include the 1,5% military levy and social security tax, which is around $50 per employee.

Let’s look at other offshore development team Ukraine facts in the table below.

Poland

Opting for offshore software development Poland is a promising venture. The country’s economy has been experiencing stable growth since joining the EU in 2004. There are about 60,000 tech companies in Poland, and ten out of them are unicorns.

Offshore development Poland is favorable for entrepreneurs. The country ranked 40th out of 140 global economies in terms of ease of doing business, as Statista suggests.

Consider other factors that may influence your decision to hire developers in Poland:

Romania

Choosing offshore software development Romania means tapping into the thriving tech landscape. The country’s software market revenue surpassed $347 million in 2023 and is set for a 6.65% yearly growth from 2023 to 2028. Enterprise software is the main market’s driver, accounting for over $142 million in revenue in 2023.

Romanian software developers bring other perks and opportunities:

Belarus

The Belarusian IT sector is export-oriented, with its most significant growth taking place between 2015 and 2021. In 2021, the country’s tech exports reached $3.8 billion, constituting 5.5% of the nation’s GDP. Besides, over 5,200 students graduated in the ICT specialties that year.

Yet, offshore software development Belarus opportunities were undermined by the political persecution of Belarusians and the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Between March and December 2022, the country’s IT companies experienced a dramatic outflow of over 17,000 employees, nearly 20% of the total workforce. Hopefully, plenty of Belarus citizens relocated to countries like Ukraine and Poland, having found refuge there.

If you are determined to hire programmers in Belarus or locate Belarusian experts in other countries, consider the following stats:

Asia’s Offshore Software Development Countries

Enormous and versatile talent pools and reasonable cost of offshore software development are all about India, the Philippines, and Vietnam. Let’s look at these countries separately and explore their tech scenes in greater depth.

India

Given the vast talent pool, offshore software development India is a perfect option for businesses looking for diverse and the most unique skills. Even better, hiring such experts becomes increasingly cost-effective as the Indian tech industry decentralizes into 26 smaller IT hubs. Besides Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kolkata, more technology hubs have emerged, with Jaipur, Kanpur, Vellore, Nashik, and others among them.

The software market in India is promising as well. It has already reached $8.44 billion in 2023 and will expand at an 11.31% rate during 2023 and 2028 to ultimately surpass $14 billion in revenue. On top of that, the high-tech exports of offshore development India exceeded $27 billion in 2021, following the World Bank data.

Consider even more stats on Indian software developers:

The Philippines

The offshore software development Philippines proves to be startup-oriented. According to the Asian Development Bank, the most advanced industries are FinTech and eCommerce, yet EdTech, HealthTech, AgriTech, and GreenTech emerge as well.

The Filipino IT services market is steadily expanding at a 10.69% yearly rate, projected to grow from $1.95 billion in 2023 to $3.24 billion in 2028. Statista also adds that BPO accounts for most of the market’s volume —  $0.62 billion in 2023.

Before you decide to hire developers in Philippines, go through the following stats:

Vietnam

Offshore software development Vietnam is a lucrative opportunity for businesses to tap into innovation, consistent growth, and favorable labor costs. As the Financial Times states, this country’s tech sector will expand at %8.9 annually between 2022 and 2026.

As per the same report, connectivity, device penetration, digital payments, and entertainment tech are becoming prevalent, solidifying the country’s position as a major Vietnam offshore development center service for these industries.

Offshore development Vietnam is also a viable option for companies that aim to drive Web 3.0 to the forefront. The country already hosts about 3,800 blockchain-related projects and keeps up its progress in this area.

If you want to hire software developers in Vietnam, look at the following facts and stats:

Best Countries to Choose in Latin America

LATAM countries like Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and Argentina are gaining momentum along with such destinations as Ukraine offshore development. Let’s review them in greater depth.

Brazil

Brazil dominates the Latin American IT market with a substantial 40% share. It also holds the 10th spot on the global IT stage, making Brazil offshore software development an exceptional opportunity for businesses.

If you’re determined to hire developers in Brazil, the following stats might support your decision:

Mexico

Offshore software development in Mexico brings several advantages: a skilled workforce, reasonable costs, and government support for IT initiatives. No wonder this country is a significant high-tech exporter, with exports valued at almost $75 billion in 2021.

On top of that, offshore development in Mexico allows businesses to locate certified and well-educated professionals. About 20% of all Mexican graduates have engineering degrees, totaling over 110,000 yearly.

Before you hire software developers in Mexico, consider the following facts:

Colombia

Columbia is the top country by skill proficiency in Latin America, as Coursera points out. The nation fosters innovation in scientific, commercial, and production industries, gradually integrating technologies into them. It also plans to launch the 5G spectrum for auction, which only adds to choosing offshore software development Colombia.

If you want to locate software developers in Colombia, check out these facts first:

Argentina

Offshore software development Argentina is especially favorable for startups and small businesses. As the International Trade Administration reveals, this country accommodates 11 among 34 unicorns in Latin America.

The Argentinian government also contributes to the country’s tech industry’s success and actively invests in infrastructure. For example, they intend to expand the fiber network to over 1,200 towns, spending more than $80 million in the next 18 months.

Explore the following stats before you hire software developers in Argentina:

Other Popular Destinations for Offshore Development

Finally, let’s study the offshore development countries left in our comprehensive list. Learn more about offshore development services in Portugal, Costa Rica, the UK, the USA, and Pakistan. When discussing top offshore development destinations, the strategy to hire developers in Latin America stands out for its cost-effectiveness, diverse talent pool, and cultural compatibility with North American companies, making it a highly attractive option for businesses looking to outsource their software development needs.

Portugal

Offshore software development in Portugal is gaining as much prominence as outsourcing to Eastern Europe. That’s owing to the country’s reasonable salary rates, a rapidly growing tech scene, and an unparalleled quality of education and work.

Choosing to hire offshore development team in Portugal is a decent opportunity for emerging businesses. Consider that startups in Lisbon, the capital city, were valued at about $22,5 billion in 2022, making a 26-fold increase from 2016.

It’s also relatively effortless to gather an offshore software development team Portugal, given that about 90,000 IT students graduate each year.

If you want to hire software developers in Portugal, look at the following stats:

Costa Rica

Opting for Costa Rica offshore development is a profitable venture for tech businesses. The country is proud to offer the second-best startup ecosystem in Central America.

If you’re about to hire developers in Costa Rica, check out these stats and facts:

The UK

Offshore software development UK guarantees an established technical infrastructure and processes and top-notch project quality. Yet, it may be a costly venture for certain businesses.

The good news is that companies can choose among a decent amount of talent. Only between October 2021 and September 2022, the UK created over 1.86 million jobs in the digital industry. Computer programming constituted 1.03 million of those workplaces.

The country also accommodates 144 unicorns, 237 futurecorns, and over 85,000 startups — more than any other European nation. If you want to hire programmers in the UK, consider the following stats as well:

The USA

When it comes to salaries, the US probably has the highest offshore software development rates by country. But the specialists’ skill sets and education are worth the money.

The US also boasts the highest IT services revenue in the world. In 2023, the country made over $454 billion in profits. Other offshore software product development USA stats are as follows:
